plans.buy_case: ETR is showing classic mean-reversion setup: price compressed at lower Bollinger Band with positive RSI divergence suggesting momentum bottoming, while staying above the 200MA golden cross. The squeeze + volume spike suggests institutional accumulation before a likely relief rally. However, the neutral fundamental backdrop and lack of recent catalysts mean upside is capped to tactical mean-reversion levels rather than a breakout story.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip into 25-30 zone OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band (≈$107.50). Do not chase at current RSI 40.3—that's already half-recovered. A pullback entry gives you better risk/reward on a mean-reversion trade.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% off at middle Bollinger Band (~$112); trail stop on remainder to 50MA (111.57). Hard stop: close below 200MA ($98.42) or RSI > 70 without follow-through volume—that signals false breakout. Exit immediately if negative earnings surprise drops.
plans.timeframe: 3-5 weeks. Utilities don't swing hard; this is a mean-reversion pop back to fair value, not a multi-month rip.
plans.risk: Fundamental headwinds you don't know about yet. The lack of recent news is actually a red flag for a utility—these names usually have steady coverage. Could be brewing bad guidance or regulatory issues. If ETR breaks below $98, technical support evaporates fast.

plans.buy_case: COP is showing textbook mean-reversion setup with RSI divergence (price made lower low while RSI held higher), BB squeeze, and volume confirmation—classic pre-bounce pattern. Price is anchored above 200MA with golden cross intact, reducing downside risk. However, RSI at 52 is already moderately elevated, so you're entering post-signal rather than at peak oversold.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to pull back into 40-45 range on a minor pullback, OR buy on first touch of lower BB ($111.50) with volume confirmation. Do NOT chase at current RSI 52—you're late to the reversal signal.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at 50MA resistance (~$122.40) or RSI >70. Hard stop: close below 200MA ($102.32) on high volume signals trend break.
plans.risk: Energy sector is policy-sensitive and commodity-driven—a geopolitical shock or hawkish energy transition announcement could gap you below 200MA fast. Fundamental health rated 'neutral' means no earnings catalyst tailwind. RSI already at midpoint reduces margin of safety for mean-reversion thesis.
plans.note_for_student: This is a decent setup but not screaming conviction. The RSI divergence is the strongest signal here, but you're entering after it's already partially played out. If you're time-constrained (busy semester), consider waiting for a cleaner setup where RSI actually dips into your 20-30 buy zone. COP will be around next week—don't force it. Position sizing at 10 shares (~$1,140) is appropriately conservative given your $3,440 portfolio.

plans.buy_case: XOM is showing textbook mean-reversion setup with price at lower Bollinger Band (0.19 pct) while RSI divergence signals oversold conditions may be reversing. The stock sits above its 200MA with a golden cross in place, giving you a quality energy name with fundamental tailwinds (dividend yield, cash generation) at a tactically weak point.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to drop into 25–30 zone OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band ($143.50–$144.00) on next dip. Do not chase here at RSI 52—you're already late to the reversal signal.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at upper Bollinger Band (~$152–$154) or if RSI exceeds 70 with weakening volume. Hard stop: close if price breaks below 200MA (130.27) on high volume or if energy sector breaks down on geopolitical/demand shock.
plans.risk: Oil price collapse, recession fears crushing energy demand, or geopolitical de-escalation reducing crude. At $3,440 portfolio size, $1,017 position (30% allocation) is aggressive—a 10% loss costs $102. RSI divergence can fail, and lower band bounces don't always hold.

plans.buy_case: AME is firing a textbook mean-reversion setup: Bollinger Band squeeze with RSI divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low) suggests capitulation is complete and reversal is brewing. The golden cross + price above 200MA provide solid directional bias, and above-average volume confirms institutional interest in this quality industrial compounder.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip into the 20-30 buy zone (currently 38.6), or price to touch/breach the lower Bollinger Band. Do not chase at current levels—you have time. Confirm entry with a 1.62x+ volume spike on the bounce.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at upper BB (~237–240) or if RSI hits 70+. Hard stop: close if price breaks below 200MA (208.45) on heavy volume, signaling trend reversal. Also monitor earnings/guidance—any negative surprise is a reason to exit regardless of technicals.
plans.risk: Macro headwinds (industrial demand weakness, rate surprise) could sink this despite technicals. Absence of recent news is a red flag—you must review latest earnings call and guidance before executing. At $225.85, you're not getting a discount; if it dips to $220, the risk/reward improves materially.

plans.buy_case: SRE is showing classic mean-reversion setup: price squeezed near lower Bollinger Band with positive RSI divergence (price makes lower low while RSI holds higher), suggesting oversold conditions may be reversing. Golden cross + volume spike on technicals align well with your framework, and utilities offer defensive stability during uncertain markets.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to drop into your 20-30 buy zone (currently 41.2 is too high). Enter on bounce from lower BB band OR on pullback that brings RSI into 20-30 range. Do not chase at 89.13.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% at +4% (91.00); trail stop on remaining at RSI >70 or if price closes below 50MA (94.08). Exit full position if fundamentals deteriorate or utility sector breaks 200MA support.
plans.risk: Utilities are rate-sensitive; any Fed pivot toward higher rates kills the thesis. At $1,070 position size you're risking ~$130 to $150 on this trade—manage downside discipline. RSI divergence is bullish *signal* but not guarantee; watch volume confirmation on any bounce.
